summary: Defines a data transfer protocol for moving data between hosts on the ARPANET, written by a group of authors from MIT, UCLA, BBN, Rand, SRI, Harvard and UCSB. It updates RFC 114 and works with the file transfer protocol. It was replaced by RFC 264.

eli5.summary: The delivery truck for data. It sets simple rules for how the box is packed and sent so many different computers can send things to each other.
